sightradar.description: Official SightRadar Face Recognition API MCP: index photos into collections, find every photo of a person from one selfie, compare and detect faces, run batches of photo URLs, and check credits and usage. Streamable HTTP, OAuth sign-in with a SightRadar account in the browser (or an API key as a Bearer token); each connection gets its own revocable key and chosen permission groups. Billable tools state their price in credits; deletes are soft by default with a 7-day restore window, while immediate and compliance deletes are permanent.
